name: Slider
description: A carousel of images with optional title, text and button per slide. Without JavaScript it is a snapping horizontal scroller; Embla adds paging, arrows and dots.

perView.description: Slides visible at once on wide screens.

caption.description: Caption under the image, or over its lower edge on a gradient.

slides.label: Slides

imageAlt.label: Image description
imageAlt.description: What the image shows, for readers who cannot see it.

text.label: Text
text.description: A line or two under the heading.

ctaLabel.label: Button label
ctaLabel.description: Button text; the slide has no button without it.

slides.description: Slides: the image's address and text, and an optional link (ctaLabel + ctaHref).

loop.description: Wrap from the last slide to the first.

id.description: Unique on the page: names the track that the previous/next buttons control (aria-controls).

eyebrow.label: Eyebrow
eyebrow.description: A short line above the heading.

actions.label: Buttons

href.label: Link
href.description: Where the button goes: a page on this site or a full address.

newTab.label: Open in a new tab
newTab.description: Open the link in a new tab (an external site the reader should not leave for).

style.label: Style
style.description: primary for the main action, secondary or ghost for the ones beside it.

actions.description: Buttons under the intro, in order; none by default.

measured.description: The source section's measured style (MeasuredStyle): frame width, padding, fill, image, columns per width, gap, text tone, radius, minimum height — all in pixels. Absent, the site's tokens; present, it wins over tone and columns. Values that are not a number, a colour or a known keyword are dropped.

color.description: Fill colour: hex, rgb(a) or hsl(a).

image.description: Background image address (http(s) or root-relative), drawn behind the content.

overlay.description: Colour or linear/radial gradient laid over the image or the fill.

size.description: cover, contain or auto; anything else draws as cover.

position.description: One or two of center/top/bottom/left/right or percentages.

columns.description: Slides in view at 390 (base), 768 (md) and 1280 (lg) px; a missing width follows the narrower one. Wins over perView.

tone.description: What the text is set for: dark = light text on a dark band. Without it, a fill's own lightness decides.

align.description: Where the heading and lead sit; read by a component whose own align is not set.

a11y: WAI-ARIA carousel pattern: a labelled region with aria-roledescription=carousel, slides as labelled groups ('Slide 2 of 5'), labelled previous/next buttons disabled at the ends, and dot buttons marking the current slide. The track and the buttons are tied by aria-controls, the row takes focus (arrow keys page it, polite live announcement). There is no autoplay, so nothing moves unasked; with prefers-reduced-motion slides change without animation. Without JavaScript every slide is reachable by scrolling.
